limits: One reused development checkpoint lineage; conditions and queries are correlated
Actual captured decoder outputs replayed by an adapter; no checkpoint policy inference
Stock dispatcher/MessagePack/selected custom schemas; no WebSocket client/server run
Authored raw-index schemas do not supply physical units, gripper conventions or robot state
All available numerical statistics supplied as metadata; native structural validation has a different scope
Float64 decoder values become float32 on the native wire; roundoff is reported without a safety threshold
Transport acceptance is not a semantic miss, certification, task success or evidence of superiority
